summary: This topic explains how to efficiently assign transport routes and pick-up points to multiple students simultaneously using an Excel upload. This is particularly useful for promoting students with existing transport details.
steps: Navigate to Settings icon > Transport > Transport Excel Upload.
Download the provided sample Excel file.
Fill the Excel file with the following student details:
Student's unique ID (Reg Number or Admission Number).
The exact 'Vehicle Route Name' as defined in the Vehicle Route setup.
The exact 'Pick-up Point Name' as defined in the Vehicle Route setup.
Choose the completed Excel file from your system.
Click 'Submit' to upload the file and assign the transport data to the students.
business_rules: The student's Reg Number/Admission Number serves as the unique identifier for assigning transport.
The Vehicle Route Name and Pick-up Point Name in the Excel file must precisely match the names configured in the system.
Upon successful assignment, the system will automatically fetch and apply the corresponding transport fees to the student's demand based on the assigned route and pick-up point.
important_notes: This feature is primarily designed for bulk assignment, especially when promoting students from a previous session where their transport details are expected to remain similar.
The Excel file for upload does not require the vehicle number, as the route name implicitly links to the assigned vehicle.
If there are errors in the uploaded data, the system will generate an error file to help identify and correct issues.
To prepare the Excel for an upcoming session, you can export the transport report from the previous session, adjust it as needed, and then upload it.
